skills.name: Like-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators (and whole number parts) when the fractions involved already share the same denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert unlike fractions before subtracting.

skills.name: Regrouping/borrowing
skills.definition: Borrow one whole unit (converted to the fractional denominator) from the whole-number part when the subtrahend's fraction is larger than the minuend's fraction.

skills.name: Improper fraction conversion
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is equal to or greater than one into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.

skills.name: Whole number minus fraction/mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part (borrowing) in order to subtract a fraction or mixed number from it.
